Steps: 1. Enter valid credentials. 2. Log out. 3. Enter a wrong password.
Expected Result: Valid: role home page shown. Invalid: error shown, no access.
Actual Result: No login screen is drawn in the wireframes.

Steps: 1. Open the catalog. 2. Enter a course code. 3. Click Search.
Actual Result: Screen 8.1 shows a search box, filters, a Go button and a results table of courses.

Steps: 1. Open the catalog. 2. Click a course.
Expected Result: Credits, schedule, faculty, seats left, and prerequisites are shown.
Actual Result: Screen 8.2 shows credits, schedule, faculty, seats left and prerequisite.

Steps: 1. Log in as student. 2. Select an open course. 3. Click Register.
Expected Result: Course is added to my list and a confirmation is shown.
Actual Result: Screen 8.2 has a Register button and a 'Registered successfully' message; screen 8.3 lists registered courses.

Steps: 1. Select a course with no seats. 2. Click Register. 3. Accept the waitlist.
Expected Result: Waitlist is offered; waitlist position is shown after joining.
Actual Result: Screen 8.2 shows 'Course full' with a Join waitlist option; screen 8.3 shows 'Waitlist #2'.

Steps: 1. Hold a course. 2. Register for another with an overlapping time.
Expected Result: Registration blocked; clashing course is named.
Actual Result: Screen 8.2 shows the message 'Blocked: clashes with MA201' which names the clashing course.

Steps: 1. Register for a course without its prerequisite. 2. Register for a course that exceeds the credit limit.
Expected Result: Both blocked with the specific reason shown.
Actual Result: Screen 8.2 shows a missing-prerequisite message, but no message is drawn for exceeding the credit limit (screen 8.3 only shows 10 / 24).

Steps: 1. Open my registered courses. 2. Click Drop on one.
Expected Result: Course removed, seat released, confirmation shown.
Actual Result: Screen 8.3 has a Drop button, but no confirmation message or seat release is drawn.

Steps: 1. Log in as faculty. 2. Open own course.
Actual Result: No faculty class list screen is drawn.

Steps: 1. Log in as admin. 2. Create a course. 3. Edit its seat limit. 4. Close it.
Expected Result: Changes appear in the catalog; closed course rejects registration.
Actual Result: Screen 8.4 shows New Course, Edit and Close buttons, but no create or edit form and no 'course closed' message for students are drawn.

Steps: 1. Register for a course. 2. Drop it.
Expected Result: A notification is received for each action.
Actual Result: No notification screen or message is drawn.

Steps: 1. Log in as admin. 2. Choose a department. 3. Export the report.
Expected Result: Report shows enrolled and waitlisted counts.
Actual Result: Screen 8.4 has an Export Enrolment Report button, but no report layout with enrolled and waitlisted counts is drawn.
